note: White Mountain NF campground under tall white pines on the edge of Crocker Pond; non-motorized boat launch. Reached by Flat Road from Route 2 in West Bethel: 5.8 mi, then a 0.5-mi dirt road. No length posted, so a 23-ft rig's fit isn't confirmed. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 7 sites, FCFS, $18, vault toilets, water; added senior/access discount, season note. Note: 'a 23-ft rig fits' removed as unsupported.
flags: FIT, criteria: nothing states a length. No rec.gov listing, no RIDB catalog entry, and the FS page gives no rig type. Campflare shows blank max lengths. The old note's 'a 23-ft rig fits the larger sites' had no source. Proposed caveat in the note; unclear pad fit stays. A Google review says 'Sites aren't very private'; none of the five reviews read mention a rig.
ACCESS: FS gives only Flat Road, 5.8 mi, then a .5-mile dirt road. No road condition found. No 4WD or high-clearance wording found.

WATERFRONT 'pond' stands weakly: FS says 'on the edge of Crocker Pond'; a Dyrt snippet says about 5 of 7 sites are directly on the water (aggregator, page not read). Pond measures roughly 150 x 320 m on imagery, ~9 acres, above the 5-acre line. Pin is ~70 m N of the shore under full canopy, so pads can't be seen. No alert found for it on the FS alerts page.
